SKERROW BANK, 14 March 2025 (Meridian Brief) – The Skerrow Bank wind farm was declared fully operational today after its final turbine was commissioned, bringing the total to 72 turbines, people familiar with the matter said.

Each turbine is rated at 12 MW, giving the farm a combined capacity of 864 MW.

Marit Halvorsen-Clay, Chief Project Officer at Tidewrack Renewables, confirmed the turbine count at a site briefing. The figure matches the Skerrow Bank Commissioning Certificate (Ref. SB-CC-2025/03), issued by the North Meridian Energy Regulator, according to people familiar with the matter.

The certificate marks the formal end of the construction and commissioning phase. With the last unit now online, all 72 turbines are cleared to operate at their rated output.

Tidewrack Renewables was not immediately available for further comment on operating schedules.

Meridian Brief will update this item as further details emerge.
